reforms.description: The government has begun to promote reform of state-run universities to enhance competition and improve research quality, including the introduction of 'Centres of Excellence' based on performance assessments. This initiative is part of a broader strategy to identify barriers to innovation and propose regulatory reforms and technology programs to stimulate supply and meet latent consumer demand, alongside increasing joint research projects between industry and universities to enhance innovation capacity.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Enhancing competition and improving research quality in universities is expected to raise productivity and innovation capacity.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has begun to promote reform of state-run universities.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reform represents a structural change in the university system aimed at improving research quality and innovation.
reforms.source_quote: The government plans to select around ten to twenty 'Centres of Excellence' in 10 major subjects based on a performance assessment by a third party, and to allocate more funds to them so as to provide a strong incentive to improve the quality of their research.

reforms.description: The government has established Technology Licensing Organisations (TLO) to promote technology transfer from universities to the private sector, allowing researchers to work with private companies. This initiative is complemented by a portion of research funds received from industry staying with universities, promoting collaboration and enhancing the commercialization of research outputs.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Facilitating technology transfer and collaboration between academia and industry is expected to enhance innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has established Technology Licensing Organisations (TLO) to promote technology transfer.
reforms.importance_rationale: The establishment of TLOs and the promotion of collaboration represent significant but narrower reforms in the innovation landscape.
reforms.source_quote: Since FY2000, a portion of research funds received from industry stays with the university, and contracts can now run longer than a fiscal year.

reforms.description: The government has introduced a new law allowing private developers to manage city planning for designated urban areas, which aims to facilitate efficient land use by easing existing regulations.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Facilitating efficient land use is expected to enhance urban development and economic activity.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has introduced a new law allowing private developers to manage city planning.
reforms.importance_rationale: The introduction of a new law represents a significant reform in urban planning and development.
reforms.source_quote: A new law has been introduced to allow private developers and planners to manage city planning for designated sites in urban areas regardless of existing regulations.

reforms.description: The government proposed the creation of 'special structural reform zones' to allow local authorities to identify and waive regulatory barriers to development, facilitating entrepreneurship and foreign direct investment.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Facilitating entrepreneurship and foreign direct investment is expected to enhance economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government proposed the creation of 'special structural reform zones'.
reforms.importance_rationale: The proposal represents a significant reform aimed at enhancing the startup ecosystem.
reforms.source_quote: An important initiative proposed by the central government is the creation of 'special structural reform zones'.

reforms.description: The government has introduced a basic plan to allocate 24 trillion yen over five years to enhance public technology efficiency, focusing on IT, environment, biotechnology, and nanotechnology.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Allocating significant funding to enhance technology efficiency is expected to raise productivity and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has introduced a basic plan to allocate 24 trillion yen.
reforms.importance_rationale: The allocation of 24 trillion yen represents a major public investment in technology efficiency.
reforms.source_quote: The basic plan adopted in March 2001 envisages allocating 24 trillion yen over the next five years to four areas: IT, environment, biotechnology and nanotechnology.

reforms.description: The government is providing support for start-ups through management training, loans, subsidies, and special tax treatment to encourage entrepreneurship.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Providing comprehensive support for startups is expected to enhance innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government is providing support for start-ups.
reforms.importance_rationale: The support for startups represents a significant but narrower reform in the innovation ecosystem.
reforms.source_quote: Support for start-ups including management training, loans, subsidies and special tax treatment is provided by the government.

reforms.description: The government announced a national broadband initiative aimed at promoting the deployment of high speed/ultra high speed Internet infrastructure to enhance ICT use and diffusion across Japan.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Enhancing ICT infrastructure is expected to facilitate innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government announced a national broadband initiative.
reforms.importance_rationale: The national broadband initiative represents a significant investment in research infrastructure.
reforms.source_quote: The government believes that ICT use will be a major force driving future growth and socio-economic developments and to this end has announced a national broadband initiative.

reforms.description: The government has set targets for establishing 1000 venture companies stemming from universities within three years and aims to increase the number of intellectual property rights granted by universities tenfold within a decade.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Setting ambitious targets for venture companies is expected to stimulate innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has set targets for establishing 1000 venture companies.
reforms.importance_rationale: The initiative represents a significant but narrower reform aimed at enhancing the startup ecosystem.
reforms.source_quote: The government has set targets for the establishment of 1000 venture companies stemming from universities within three years.

reforms.description: The government is moving to create a more open and transparent industry-science relationship, aiming to remove disincentives to cooperation between universities and national research institutions.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Creating a more open relationship is expected to enhance collaboration and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The government is moving to create a more open and transparent industry-science relationship.
reforms.importance_rationale: The initiative represents a significant but narrower reform aimed at improving knowledge transfer.
reforms.source_quote: The government’s move to create a more open and transparent industry-science relationship and to remove the disincentives to co-operation facing the universities and the NRIs goes in the right direction.

reforms.description: The government has allocated supplementary budget funds to promote knowledge-intensive clusters and foster venture business at universities and technology licensing organizations.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Promoting knowledge-intensive clusters is expected to enhance innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has allocated supplementary budget funds.
reforms.importance_rationale: The allocation of supplementary funds represents a significant but narrower reform in the startup ecosystem.
reforms.source_quote: Funds are also allocated to promoting knowledge-intensive clusters and fostering venture business at universities and technology licensing organisations (TLOs).
